_comment: IELTS Speaking savollar bazasi. part: 1 (oddiy savollar), 2 (cue card + 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik + 2 daqiqa javob), 3 (chuqur muhokama).

questions.question: Do you work or are you a student?
What subject are you studying, and why did you choose it?
Where is your hometown, and what is it like?
What do you like most about your hometown?
What do you usually do in your free time?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities? Why?
What kind of food do you like to eat?
Do you enjoy cooking? Why or why not?
How often do you use your mobile phone?
What apps do you use most, and why?
Do you like travelling? Why?
What is your favourite kind of weather?
What kind of music do you listen to?
Do you read books in your free time?
Do you play any sports or do exercise?
Describe a person who has influenced you.
questions.cue_card: Describe a person who has had a strong influence on your life.
bullets: And explain why they influenced you

questions.question: Describe a place you would like to visit.
questions.cue_card: Describe a place you have never been to but would like to visit.
bullets: And explain why you want to visit it

questions.question: Describe a memorable event in your life.
questions.cue_card: Describe a memorable event you attended.
bullets: And explain why it was memorable

questions.question: Describe an object you use every day.
questions.cue_card: Describe an object that you use every day.
bullets: How long you have had it
And explain why it is important to you

questions.question: Describe a skill you have learned.
questions.cue_card: Describe a skill you have recently learned.
bullets: And explain how you feel about it

questions.question: Describe a book or film that impressed you.
questions.cue_card: Describe a book or film that made a strong impression on you.
bullets: When you read or watched it
And explain why it impressed you

questions.question: Describe a quiet place you like to go to.
questions.cue_card: Describe a quiet place where you like to spend time.
bullets: And explain why you like it

questions.question: Describe something you are proud of.
questions.cue_card: Describe something you achieved that you are proud of.
bullets: And explain why you are proud of it

questions.question: How has education changed in your country over the last 20 years?
Do you think exams are a fair way to measure ability?
How has technology changed the way people communicate?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace many jobs? Why?
Why do some people prefer to live in cities rather than the countryside?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media for young people?
What can individuals do to protect the environment?
Should governments do more to reduce pollution? How?
What makes a good leader in the workplace?
Is it better to work for a company or to be self-employed?
How important is it to preserve traditional culture?
Why do you think some people ignore health advice?
What effects does globalisation have on local cultures?
How reliable is the news we read online today?
